recent_posts.title: typescript v0.2.0
recent_posts.summary: AshTypescript v0.2.0 automatically generates TypeScript types and RPC clients from Elixir Ash resources, providing end-to-end type safety between backend and frontend. Features include zero-config type generation, smart field selection, Phoenix Channel support, multitenancy handling, Zod schema generation for runtime validation, and comprehensive filtering capabilities. The library eliminates manual API type writing by creating fully type-safe client functions directly from Ash resource definitions.

recent_posts.title: Advanced inserts with Ecto
recent_posts.summary: Explores advanced Ecto techniques for optimizing database inserts, including using SQL queries as values in insert_all operations to avoid expensive joins and reduce database roundtrips. Demonstrates how to use placeholders to minimize data transfer when inserting multiple records with repeated values. Shows practical examples from real-world scenarios where these optimizations solved performance bottlenecks and prevented downtime.

recent_posts.title: Agent Jido · Agent Jido
recent_posts.summary: ReqLLM is a new Elixir library that provides a unified, plugin-based interface for interacting with multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, etc.) through the Req HTTP client ecosystem. It offers structured data generation, streaming support, automatic cost tracking, and maintains provider-specific capabilities while normalizing API differences. The library supports 45 providers and 665+ models with auto-synced metadata, built-in tool calling, and secure key management.

recent_posts.title: Master Ash Framework [Ep. 0]: Complete SaaS Overview - Authorization, Multi-Tenancy & Stripe
recent_posts.summary: A comprehensive walkthrough of building a production-ready multi-tenant SaaS task management application using Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, and the Ash framework. The tutorial covers context-based multi-tenancy with automatic data isolation, real-time collaboration features, role-based access control, Stripe billing integration, and activity tracking. The application includes user authentication, organization management, project and task management with Kanban boards, team invitations, and real-time updates across users.

recent_posts.title: Running Flutter apps on Nerves embedded devices with NervesFlutterSupport
recent_posts.summary: NervesFlutterSupport is a library that enables running Flutter UI applications on Nerves embedded devices. It includes pre-compiled runtime libraries, Sony's Flutter Embedder, Mix Release Steps for automatic compilation, and modules for engine management. The library has been tested on Raspberry Pi 4 and 5, supports aarch64-based Nerves systems, and provides an example project demonstrating gRPC communication between Nerves firmware and Flutter applications.

recent_posts.title: Keynote: A New Case for Elixir - Bruce Tate and Josh Price | ElixirConf US 2025
recent_posts.summary: Bruce Tate and Josh Price present a keynote exploring how AI impacts Elixir development, arguing that Elixir's foundational strengths become even more valuable in an AI-driven world. They trace personal programming journeys from Java through Ruby to Elixir, highlighting how Elixir's flexible abstractions, concurrency model, and solid foundations built on the BEAM virtual machine position it uniquely for the future. The speakers discuss the tension between deterministic programming and AI's non-deterministic nature, advocating for combining both approaches while building on reliable foundations rather than shaky AI-generated code.

recent_posts.title: Keynote: Elixir's AI Future - Chris McCord | ElixirConf US 2025
recent_posts.summary: Chris McCord presents Elixir's strategic position in the AI agent era, demonstrating how the language's OTP architecture naturally solves complex agent orchestration problems that other ecosystems struggle with. He showcases practical AI integration through Phoenix's agents.md file and live coding demos, arguing that Elixir's developer-first tooling and cohesive ecosystem make it ideal for both building with AI agents and building AI agents themselves. The talk emphasizes keeping agent architectures simple while leveraging Elixir's inherent advantages in concurrent, fault-tolerant systems.

recent_posts.title: Elixir Update & Q&A - José Valim | ElixirConf US 2025
recent_posts.summary: José Valim presents Elixir 1.19 updates at ElixirConf US 2025, highlighting major compile time improvements that can yield up to 4x faster build times on large projects through lazy loading of compiled modules and parallel dependency compilation. The type system continues evolving with support for maps with any keys, anonymous functions, and protocol type checking, now providing precise support for all data types. The release candidate addresses community feedback on performance, struct update syntax deprecation, and Erlang OTP 28 compatibility. Two community initiatives are announced: an outreach stipend for speakers and a global Elixir meetup week in September. The Elixir Language Server is now publicly available in alpha status with nightly builds.

recent_posts.title: LiveDebugger feedback survey
recent_posts.summary: LiveDebugger is conducting a 5-minute feedback survey to understand how developers currently use their debugging tool and gather input on potential new features. The survey responses will directly influence the product's development roadmap.

recent_posts.title: Building Terminal Applications With Elixir - Gary Rennie | ElixirConf EU 2025 | ElixirConf EU 2025
recent_posts.summary: Gary Rennie presents Termite, a dependency-free Elixir library for building terminal applications. The library leverages OTP26's primty module to handle input/output without external NIFs, supports escape sequences for colors and cursor control, and includes alt screen functionality. Termite features an adapter-based architecture and declarative API for styling terminal output. The talk demonstrates practical examples including a Snake game and introduces Breeze, an experimental LiveView-inspired framework for terminal UIs built on top of Termite.
